title: S2S-Arena, Evaluating Speech2Speech Protocols on Instruction Following with Paralinguistic Information

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing pairwise comparisons by swapping candidate presentation order to measure whether human evaluators or automated speech model judges disproportionately favor the first or second option.
Calculating and comparing the average duration (in seconds) of winning versus losing speech outputs to determine if evaluators inherently favor longer responses.
